statements.text: About 700 agencies surveyed in 43 states; Flock technology 'supported' about 1 million investigations in 2025, about 20% of cleared cases; about 10,000 missing persons located. Flock's own caveat: 'directional estimates rather than audited totals'.
More than 20 billion plate scans a month across the network, per Flock's website as reported in November 2025.

statements.who: Mourtgos and Adams, working paper, August 2026
statements.text: Staggered event study of 216 agencies that adopted Flock from 2017 to 2023 against about 3,100 that did not: motor vehicle theft down 11% and theft arrests up 15.9%. Not peer reviewed; the authors worked with Flock to obtain deployment data. The Institute for Justice says thefts were already falling before deployment and that the drop appears only when agencies with larger theft problems are weighted more heavily; averaged across agencies, it finds no statistically significant change.
More than 200 documented misuse or error incidents, including 27 wrongful stops or detentions, compiled from news and records.
